messages:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate across us-west1/us-east1. Aggregated error rate 12% over 3m. Symptoms: model-runner processes exiting with segfaults and GPU resets. Pager routed to #incidents and oncall.

olivia (oncall): I'm on it. Start collecting scope. Which clusters/versions? is traffic spiky?

kevin-runtime: seeing it in both prod clusters. Error surge started ~17:12 UTC. Logs show repeated SIGSEGV from model-runner worker in runtime.cc:423. Also GPU watchdog resets on some nodes — possible kernel/GPU firmware interaction.

kira (eng): adding logs — here's a snippet from node0 model-runner:
```
[2025-06-12T17:13:02Z] model-runner[pid=8421]: ERROR runtime.cc:423] segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f8a9bcd ret 0x7f8a9b000
[2025-06-12T17:13:02Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[2025-06-12T17:13:03Z] systemd: model-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=11/SEGV
```

kevin-runtime: on top of segfaults, several pods OOMKilled around same time. suspect latent memory leak when auto-batching large batch sizes hits quantized kernel path.

sre-bot: Suggested immediate mitigations: 1) Reduce batch_size to 1 for live serving route 2) Route traffic to fallback model variant `gpt-small-qdq` 3) Scale up model-runner replicas by 3 4) Cordon affected nodes for investigation

olivia (oncall): Execute mitigations. Kevin, can you apply traffic reroute and smaller batch? Kira/kevin, coordinate.

kevin-runtime: applying routing change now — updating router config to shift 100% of /v1/generate to `model=gpt-small-qdq` for all prod routes.
```
# routerctl
routerctl set-weight --route /v1/generate --model gpt-small-qdq --weight 100
```

kevin-runtime: reducing default batching and disabling quantized kernel for the heavy model as stopgap.
```
# runtime flags
RUNTIME_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 -> 128
RUNTIME_ENABLE_QDQ=0
```

kira (eng): scaling model-runner deployment to 6 replicas across both zones.
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-runner --replicas=6
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-runner -o wide
```

support-liaison: Noting customer impact — error rate peaked at 21% for one large PLG customer (realtime generation). About 12 paid customers saw increased 5xx; mobile SDK telemetry shows retries increased and some timeouts.

olivia (oncall): Good. Marking customer-impacting = true and paging support. Sending status update to customers channel.

support-liaison: Posting customer broadcast draft:
```
We’re investigating elevated errors on generation endpoints. Mitigations in progress: temporary routing to smaller model to restore availability. No data loss expected. Will follow up with ETA.
```

kevin-runtime: After routing to gpt-small-qdq and disabling QDQ, error rate fell to 1.8% in 4 minutes. Latency stable. Some nodes still show GPU resets during stress tests; cordoned 3 nodes for deeper debug.

kira (eng): Collected core dump from one failed pod and ran quick addr2line — points to kv_cache::writeBlob at runtime/cache.cc:287. I'm pushing a quick patch to guard null pointer there.

kevin-runtime: building hotfix image with patch, will deploy as canary to 1 replica then roll.

kira (eng): hotfix image built: redwood/model-runner:v1.2.3-hotfix-kvcache

kevin-runtime: rolling canary
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=redwood/model-runner:v1.2.3-hotfix-kvcache
```

sre-bot: Canary healthy for 5m. No segfaults observed on canary pod.

kevin-runtime: rolling full rollout now. Monitoring.

olivia (oncall): support-liaison — any paid customers requiring immediate escalation or credits?

support-liaison: One customer on SLO-sensitive plan reported timeouts — ops flagged. I offered temporary traffic cutover to dedicated capacity; they accepted. Cutover initiated.

sre-bot: After full rollout, error rate back to baseline 0.3% and sustained for 20m. GPU resets ceased on cordoned nodes; further investigation scheduled.

olivia (oncall): Great. I'm closing active pager. Creating follow-up postmortem and assigning owners: kevin-runtime (hotfix & rollout), kira (root cause analysis), support-liaison (customer communications).

kira (eng): ETA for RCA doc by EOD tomorrow. Initial hypothesis: memory corruption in kv_cache triggered by combined QDQ kernel path + large batched inputs -> segfault + OOM cascade causing GPU watchdog resets.

kevin-runtime: Will schedule a job to re-run heavy synthetic load against canary with debug build and address sanitizer on a test cluster.

olivia (oncall): Handoff to next oncall @kira for post-incident follow-up. I'm off shift. Good job team :tada:

sre-bot: Incident resolved. Pager closed at 17:59 UTC. Postmortem ticket created: PM-2025-321.

support-liaison: Sent customer updates and followups. Logged affected accounts and timelines.

kira (eng): Taking follow-up. Will post RCA link here when ready.

olivia (oncall): Thanks — handing off. :white_check_mark:
